135.news_title: Replace your 26inch CRT Monitor with our new 26inch 4x3 15khz Arcade LCD Monitor
135.long_description: We have been working hard for a plug and play 26inch arcade LCD panel to replace worn out or faulty CRT tube monitors. Similar to our previous models, our custom firmware is designed exclusively for the arcade industry. Our 4x3 LCD monitor offers full range support for 15khz 24khz and 31khz arcade game inputs up to 1600x1200. Our 26inch 4x3 arcade LCD monitor is a direct replacement for CRT tube screens and offers full range support for 15khz, 24khz, 31khz and up to 1600x1200 resolution via our custom firmware designed specifically for the arcade industry. Preorder opens in February, with delivery scheduled in April.
